# Agreement Name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AgreementName`](gmeow-AgreementName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AgreementName>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/agreements`](../../slices/agreements.md)

An appellation borne by an agreement — a formal title, short name, or multilingual version of a contract or legal instrument. Carries its own [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) and [`gmeow:nameScript`](../properties/gmeow-nameScript.md) so co-equal multilingual names are separate first-class objects.
